notes.title: DEAD END MISSION CHRISTMAS UPDATE!
notes.content:
KEVLAR & DIFFICULTIES
Kevlar is now in the game! You can equip Kevlar in the Arsenal! Kevlar protects you from damage and prevents you from bleeding. Kevlar will however break after two hits, so be careful! Kevlar will be repaired after picking up an Arsenal supply box! This gives the player a lot more tools to control the Mission's difficulty!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/54bb5ca5258156c141d867310a7d02f331397c8b.png

FROSTSCOPE MOD
This new scope mod can be unlocked in the Mission and can be attached to all rifles!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/80788fc4e6e5e27b08f53d22a785badd8f4091f2.png

BLOODSCOPE MOD
This new scope mod can be unlocked in the Mission and can be attached to all rifles!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/4816757565617d1ad3e2764d4c695924f8befda4.png

Balance
Normal Baby Mutants reduced movement speed.
Queen Guards reduced movement speed.
More bandages are located on the maps.
Quality Of Life Updates & More!

Be Aware!
These new updates can have a small chance of corrupting your old save files! If you get any problems with the game after this update, reset the save file and data on the menu and re-launch the game. 

Merry Christmas From RednapGames! ːBatcatː
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/0033e2bf8f41c46a9d0432b9e5f18dd6011b86ac.png

notes.title: DEM IS NOW USING RANGE ENGINE! (UPDATE)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/5a1aa2a3e11d124a6d67c532026c9e34478fd9a1.png

RANGE ENGINE
It has taken some time, but finally, DEAD END MISSION has been converted from the old UPBGE to Range Engine! This increases the game's performance in many ways and therefore also increases the gameplay experience! 

Loading times are now faster and all the game files are now compact which reduces the game's overall size!

It's just magic!

Important! Most of the saved data files have been moved to other maps, which means that some of the old saved files are not working on this version, to be sure to avoid problems with this new build, reinstall the game and reset all data on menu before playing!

Thanks for all the support and enjoy this Ranged Version of DEAD END MISSION! ːcsgocrossː

notes.title: PLAYTESTER UPDATE IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
THE FIRST DEAD END MISSION UPDATE IS HERE

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZnweAA26psM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/275192a08a2f012d72fbcef44ccad1b3edd0bbfb.png
PLAYTESTER UPDATE
I have gotten help from some amazing playtesters and the DEAD END MISSION experience has now been improved! 

Full update log below!

SWORD BLOCK
Yes! Now you can block enemy attacks with your sword to prevent taking damage!

However, you won't be able to protect yourself with the sword for too long since it needs to recharge. To block attacks, you also need to have good timing! This new mechanic will increase survival. It will block for a short period as soon as you switch to your sword!

And no, you cannot block your friendly fire grenades!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/afb5986a4b6cf311878fa9d3ca635d2363310b4e.png
SCOPING SPOTS WEAKPOINTS
The scope will now spot weak points on all mutants! This also means that you can spot the weak points from afar even before you see the mutant! You can only see the weak points when scoping in!

This gives the scope a great advantage during the mission and also shows new players where to shoot.

In DEAD END MISSION, it's not always the headshots that do the most damage!

QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES
Such as giving the player more context on where to go in the mission. Mutant spawning sound bugs fixed. The first loading cutscene is now darker so you can see the text more clearly, and more!

BALANCE
Normal Meatball Body Health was reduced from 1000 to 700 Health.
Normal Meatball Head Health was reduced from 450 to 300 Health.
Crazed Mutant Body Health was reduced from 800 to 600.
Crazed Mutant Head Health was reduced from 400 to 250.
Queen Guards Grenade Damage was reduced from 500 to 100. (Now resistant)
Queen Guards can now be stunned by sword blocks.
Queen now has a small weak point that deals more damage.
& More!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/c477386fa0407d43f275a034403b8aef61588559.png

THANKS
For all the support so far, more updates and content will come in the future! But for now, let's go kill some MUTANTS! ːwinter2019coolyulː

notes.title: HUGE "Playtester Update" is Coming!
notes.content:
DEAD END MISSION has been fortunate to receive feedback from playtesters and game designers. I, who am RednapGames, listen to good ideas that improve DEAD END MISSION so that the game gets as good as possible for the players.

So, I will be presenting two new Huge mechanics that are being worked on right now to take DEAD END MISSION to the next level!

SWORD BLOCK!
Yes! The sword needs some extra love! Soon you can block enemy attacks with your sword to prevent damage!

However, you won't be able to protect yourself with the sword for too long since it needs to recharge. To block attacks, you also need to have good timing! This new mechanic will increase survival. 

And no, you cannot block your friendly fire grenades!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/4e5a58253f38aec11e6b32cc0c07110f97eccdce.png

SCOPING SPOTS WEAKPOINTS!
This will be Huge for Sharpshooters! The scope will soon show weak points on all monsters! This also means that you can spot the weak points from afar even before you see the mutant! You can only see the weak points when scoping in!

This will give the scope a great advantage during the mission and also show new players where to shoot.

In DEAD END MISSION, it's not always in the headshots that do the most damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44466957/afb5986a4b6cf311878fa9d3ca635d2363310b4e.png

MORE!
Smaller quality-of-life updates are being worked on to guide the players better through the mission. Some mutants have gotten a revisit and made it for the better!

THANK YOU!
To all who have gotten a copy of DEAD END MISSION so far and who support me as an IndieDev! Also a big thanks to the playtesters! 

This update will be live as soon as it's Ready! ːsteamthumbsupː
